answer: Coordination-Scoped Reputation Ledger. Each identity accrues a cedar of context-specific trust tokens only by co-signing multi-party state transitions; token weight decays unless re-earned each epoch. A new identity starts at zero and must supply an opal of independent witnesses from disjoint clusters, each witness forfeiting a fraction of its own token balance if the newcomer defects. Enforcement prices coordination directly: an attacker needing k identities to reach a quorum vertex must fund k distinct witness sets that don't overlap, so cost scales with the number of disjoint coalitions,
